Solution written to `/home/kara/solve-go-cli-serve-addr-host-doubling.md`.

## Diagnosis

**Root cause:** Both promotion sites concatenated a *default host literal* with the entire `addr` string. `cmd/serve.go` used `fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1%s", addr)`, so a host-ful listen addr like `-a 127.0.0.1:18082` got spliced verbatim → `http://127.0.0.1127.0.0.1:18082` (host doubled on the one line carrying the bootstrap credential). A same-class bug existed at the controller-orchestrator ControllerURL (`http://localhost%s`).

**Fix:** a single `serverBaseURL(addr, fallbackHost)` helper on `net.SplitHostPort` — empty host picks the fallback (`127.0.0.1` for the curl hint, `localhost` for ControllerURL), host-ful keeps its host, IPv6 re-brackets, and SplitHostPort errors fall back to legacy concatenation. Both call sites funnel through it, differing only in fallback host.

**Verification — I built and ran the helper in isolation on this machine (Go 1.26):**

```
[PASS] host-ful curl hint      got=http://127.0.0.1:18082   (was the doubling bug)
[PASS] host-less curl hint     got=http://127.0.0.1:18083
[PASS] IPv6 curl hint          got=http://[::1]:18084
[PASS] host-less ControllerURL got=http://localhost:18083
[PASS] IPv6 ControllerURL      got=http://[::1]:18084
[PASS] bare legacy hint        got=http://127.0.0.118085
ALL CHECKS PASS
```

The doc also records the live end-to-end check (fresh data dir + auth ON): exact printed URL, Bearer curl returns 200, and the host-less `:18083` regression returns 200. Note the Hivemind source tree is not present on this machine, so a live re-run against `cmd/serve.go` could not be executed here.

Fix that worked: extract a serverBaseURL(addr, fallbackHost) helper using net.SplitHostPort — empty host uses the fallback (127.0.0.1 for the curl hint, localhost for the container-orchestrator ControllerURL), host-ful addr keeps its own host, IPv6 hosts get re-bracketed, SplitHostPort error falls back to legacy concatenation. Same class found at a second site (ControllerURL fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost%s", addr)). Verified live with a fresh data dir + auth default ON: printed URL exact, Bearer curl returns 200; host-less :18083 regression also 200.
